# Data import

```{r}
gs4_deauth()

gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VN0X6mcPoxDPoT_UZLsGFBOpOptBLTQxihEMyfP1n5I/edit?gid=706978554#gid=706978554"

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read(ss = ., sheet = "original") %>%
  mutate(across(1, ~ as.factor(.)))

fb %>% str()
```

```{r}
gs4_deauth()

fb_raw <- range_read(
  ss = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VN0X6mcPoxDPoT_UZLsGFBOpOptBLTQxihEMyfP1n5I/edit?gid=706978554#gid=706978554",
  sheet = "original",
  range = "A1:D19" ,
  col_types = "c" 
)
  
fb <- fb_raw %>%
  rename(
    tratamiento = 1,
    bloque_I    = 2,
    bloque_II   = 3,
    bloque_III  = 4
  ) %>%
 
  filter(grepl("^P\\d", tratamiento)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("bloque_"),
    names_to = "block",
    values_to = "brix"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
   
    brix  = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(brix))),
    block = as.factor(block),
    P     = factor(str_extract(tratamiento, "P\\d")),
    T     = factor(str_extract(tratamiento, "T\\d")),
    t     = factor(str_extract(tratamiento, "t\\d"))
  )
av <- aov(brix ~ block + P * T, data = fb)
anova(av)

mc <- emmeans(av, ~ P * T) %>%
  as.data.frame()

mc

plot_smr(mc,
         type = "bar",
         y = "emmean",
         x = "P",
         group = "T")
```


```{r}
gs4_deauth()

url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VN0X6mcPoxDPoT_UZLsGFBOpOptBLTQxihEMyfP1n5I/edit?gid=706978554#gid=706978554"

d_brix     <- range_read(url, sheet = "original", range = "A1:E19",  col_types = "c")
d_ph       <- range_read(url, sheet = "original", range = "G1:K19",  col_types = "c")
d_densidad <- range_read(url, sheet = "original", range = "M1:Q19",  col_types = "c")
d_alcohol  <- range_read(url, sheet = "original", range = "S1:W19",  col_types = "c")
d_acidez   <- range_read(url, sheet = "original", range = "Y1:AC19", col_types = "c")

# Consolidar la matriz de datos con los factores y variables numéricas

fb <- tibble(
  tratamiento = d_brix[[1]],
  P        = factor(str_extract(tratamiento, "P\\d")), # Proporción
  T        = factor(str_extract(tratamiento, "T\\d")), # Temperatura
  brix     = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(d_brix[[5]]))),
  ph       = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(d_ph[[5]]))),
  densidad = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(d_densidad[[5]]))),
  alcohol  = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(d_alcohol[[5]]))),
  acidez   = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", trimws(d_acidez[[5]])))
)

# Preparar la tabla para PCA (agrupando y promediando por factores P y T)

dtx <- fb %>%
  dplyr::select(c("P", "T", "brix", "ph", "densidad", "alcohol", "acidez")) %>%
  group_by(P, T) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite("rowname", c("P", "T"), remove = FALSE, sep = "-") %>%
  column_to_rownames("rowname") %>%
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)

mv <- dtx %>%
  PCA(
    scale.unit = TRUE,
    graph      = FALSE,
    quali.sup  = c(1, 2)
  )

var <- mv %>%
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex = 0.8)

var

cos <- mv %>%
  factoextra::fviz_pca_var(
    col.var       = "cos2",
    gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
    repel         = TRUE,
    labelsize     = 3.5
  )

cos

ind <- mv %>%
  plot.PCA(
    choix     = c("ind"),
    cex       = 0.8,
    label     = "ind",
    invisible = "quali",
    habillage = 2   
  )

ind

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv)
pcainfo

pcainfo$cor     %>% kable(caption = "Correlación de las variables con las dimensiones", digits = 3)
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Contribución de las variables (%)", digits = 2)
pcainfo$cos2    %>% kable(caption = "Calidad de representación (Cos2)", digits = 3)


cls <- mv %>% 
  HCPC(nb.clust = -1, graph = FALSE)


map <- \() { plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE) }


map()

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust %>% 
  kable(caption = "Cluster membership of each individual")  
cls$desc.var$quanti %>% 
  kable(caption = "Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster")
cls$desc.var$category%>% 
  kable(caption = "Categorical variables significantly by cluster")  
table(cls$data.clust$clust) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Number of individuals assigned to each cluster")

plot <- list(var, cos, ind, map) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/multivariate.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 30)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
